ev.q: When cleared by FDA for this purpose, serologic assays that utilize EIA rather than western immunoblot assay in a two-test format are acceptable alternatives

public_health_question.v: Should FDA-cleared modified two-test algorithms using a second EIA instead of western immunoblot be accepted for serologic diagnosis of Lyme disease?

ev.q: serologic assays that utilize a second EIA in place of western immunoblot assay are acceptable alternatives for the serologic diagnosis of Lyme disease.
Updated CDC Recommendation for Serologic Diagnosis of Lyme Disease
Updated CDC Recommendation for Serologic Diagnosis of Lyme Disease
clinicians and laboratories should consider serologic tests cleared by FDA as CDC-recommended procedures for Lyme disease serodiagnosis.

equity.level_reason: A diagnostic testing recommendation with no social-position dimension.

notes: The prepass diagnostic-accuracy cue refers to 1994 criteria for evaluating new assays (sensitivity, specificity), not to accuracy measures computed in this report. No data are reported.
